text:
Alex Carter: Heads-up — LargeBank sent a vendor risk packet asking for a completed SIG/CAIQ, our DPA with EU SCCs, and details on DSARs/data deletion SLA. They also want POC data handling and encryption details. Can we do a 30m sync tomorrow?

security-bot: Uploaded: https://drive.internal/redwood/largebank/SIG_CAICQ_v4_answers_draft (permissions: sales+security) :seedling:

Priya Nair: I can own the DPA + SCCs response. Our standard DPA + SCC annex covers processor obligations; summary for them: data deletion on hosted API endpoints is triggered at termination and final purge within 30 days by default. For Dedicated/Private: data remains customer-controlled; we provide removal runbooks and will assist with certs/keys if requested. I'll attach redlines for the DPA.

Samir Patel: For the POC we should not accept live banking PII in hosted environments. Recommend: synthetic or tokenized sample for the trial. If they insist on real records, we can do a dedicated ephemeral cluster in their VPC or a Dedicated node with CMEK + logging to their SIEM.

Maria Gomez: Sales note — LargeBank expects a 4-week POC with a security review gating production. Proposed POC commercial: 2 weeks free access to hosted sandbox + nominal fee for Dedicated test nodes (to cover GPU/ops). I'll surface exact rates to procurement in the next email.

Priya Nair: On DSARs — we handle requests proxied through the customer (controller) model. We provide logs and exports to customers to respond within their legal timelines. If LargeBank wants us to assist operationally, add a support SOW.

Samir Patel: Quick config snippet for the Dedicated POC we can share with their infra team:
```
POC baseline config:
- cluster: 1x p4d (ephemeral)
- storage: encrypted at rest (AES-256) with CMEK option
- network: private peering, no public ingress
- logs: stdout -> customer SIEM via syslog/TLS
- retention: retention policy = 30d (auto purge on termination)
```

Alex Carter: Sounds good. Can Priya/eng-security knock out the CAIQ answers by EOD Wed so I can send to their vendor risk team on Thurs? Also need a short blurb about our DPA deletion SLA and the DSAR handoff process to paste into the procurement email.

Priya Nair: I'll do the CAIQ answers — will flag any high/med items that need legal signoff. Blurb for procurement (draft):
"Redwood Inference processes customer data as a processor under a standard DPA. For hosted services Redwood deletes customer data following contract termination and completed export workflows; final purge occurs within 30 days unless otherwise contractually agreed. For Dedicated and Private deployments, data is retained in customer-controlled environments; Redwood provides removal runbooks and supports key destruction upon request."

Maria Gomez: I'll prep the procurement email and include POC commercial terms + the blurb.

Samir Patel: One more ops note — if they require Data Subject Request support handled by us, that'll need an enterprise support add-on and an access control review (we'll need a JML audit trail).

Alex Carter: Perfect. Meeting: I'll send a 30m sync invite for tomorrow 11am PT. @Priya @Samir @Maria please accept if available. :thumbsup:

security-bot: CAIQ answers draft and DPA redlines uploaded to the ticket: https://jira.internal/SEC-5482 (attachments: caiq-answers-v1.docx, dpa-redline.pdf)

Priya Nair: Accepted the invite. Will start CAIQ pass now.

Maria Gomez: Accepted. Will draft the procurement email and POC pricing options.

Samir Patel: Accepted. Will prepare POC infra checklist and sample command snippets for their infra team. :wrench:
